title: Contract Pricing Working Basis for Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
The contracted price of record on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is the gallons-weighted average of the bookings standing on the account, carried to four decimal places, adjusted as the loadings and adjustments below say and then trued to the market as the truing rule says.

A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking.

## The quantities

**The gallons standing to the member's credit** are the gallons booked on the account less the gallons drawn against those bookings.

**The weighted average** is the money committed on the bookings on the account over the gallons booked on it, carried to four decimal places.

**The protection loading.** Nothing is loaded onto the average for downside protection.

**The volume adjustment.** No volume adjustment is taken off it.

**The whole-farm adjustment.** No whole-farm adjustment is taken off it.

**The standing loading.** Nothing is loaded onto it for the standing of the booking.

**The adjusted price** is the weighted average plus the protection loading, less the volume adjustment, less the whole-farm adjustment, plus the standing loading, carried to four decimal places.

**The posted price of record** is the price billed on the most recent will-call stop, carried to four decimal places.

**The truing rule** leaves the contracted price of record at the adjusted price.

The average is taken to four decimal places before the loadings and adjustments go onto it, and the adjusted price is carried to four decimal places once they have all been taken together. The four of them are gathered in one pass rather than acting on one another in turn: each is measured against the weighted average, not against the figure the one before it left.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

Suppose an account carries bookings committing 3600.00 USD on 2000.0 gallons booked, of which 500.0 gallons have been drawn against those bookings.

- The gallons standing to the member's credit: 2000.0 less 500.0, coming to 1500.0 gallons.
- The weighted average: 3600.00 USD over 2000.0 gallons, coming to 1.8000 USD per gallon.
- The adjusted price: 1.8000 plus a protection loading of nothing, less a volume adjustment of nothing, less a whole-farm adjustment of nothing, plus a standing loading of nothing, coming to 1.8000 USD per gallon.
- The contracted price of record: the truing rule leaves it at the adjusted price, so 1.8000 USD per gallon stands on the account.
